name: renewal-brief
title: Draft software renewal brief
for_each: select id,name from contracts where status='active'

sections.title: Recorded decisions
sections.sql: select d.decision,d.rationale,d.actor,d.approver,d.evidence,d.created_at,(d.contract_snapshot->>'version')::integer=c.version current_contract_version from decisions d join contracts c on c.id=d.contract_id where contract_id=$1 order by d.created_at
sections.note: These are internal records. Confirm the current contract version before acting; nothing has been sent to the vendor.

sections.title: Licence evidence
sections.sql: select p.* from licence_position p join contracts c on c.application_id=p.id where c.id=$1

name: access-review
title: Draft application access review
for_each: select id,name from applications where status='active'

sections.title: Recorded assignments
sections.sql: select name,status,last_used_on,observed_on,review_due,evidence from assignments where application_id=$1 order by name
sections.note: A stale observation is not evidence of inactivity. A removed status records an external action and does not revoke access.
